compatibility_analysis.rejection_reason: Schema constrains structural form; the boundary records responsibility, sensitive data flow and behavioral obligations for one product seam.
The generic Contract records parties and obligations but does not close this producer-consumer interface, custody and failure shape.
Implementation records a realized capability; this boundary remains stable across candidate and successor implementations.

validation_purpose: Preserve the stable producer-consumer responsibility, data crossing, interface, invariants and failure behavior independently of option, vendor and release selection.
